items.t: What Dow Buyers Were Betting On
items.sum: If you had weighed Dow in late November 2025, you were looking at analysts split between a higher consensus target and a bearish camp arguing decarbonization and overcapacity could cap returns. For Dow shareholders, the return over the past year was 30.2%, including dividends. The company then reported stronger Q3 2026 profit and margin, cut costs and advanced nuclear power plans.
